The figures are in Table 1 ("Statistics", storage statistics) on page 9 of the paper:

| Item | Size | Page |
|---|---|---|
| Total size of fetched pages | **147.8 GB** | p. 9 |
| Compressed repository | **53.5 GB** | p. 9 |
| Lexicon | **293 MB** | p. 9 |

The text file for this paper has OCR errors in this table. It shows the three values as "117.8 GB", "5.33 GB" and "203 MB". I checked them against the page image in the PDF, which clearly shows 147.8 GB, 53.5 GB and 293 MB.

The same table lists the total with the repository as 108.7 GB, which is smaller than the 147.8 GB of fetched pages. The repository is that much smaller because it is stored compressed (p. 9).
